description: A script for bumping and managing project version numbers across multiple files and formats, including handling semantic versioning, prereleases, and updating related configuration files.

classes.name: SemVer
classes.description: A class representing semantic versioning components with methods for parsing, bumping, and formatting versions.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a version string into a SemVer object.

methods.name: without_prerelease
methods.description: Returns a SemVer object without prerelease information.

methods.name: bump
methods.description: Increments the specified version component (major, minor, patch).

methods.name: with_prerelease
methods.description: Creates a new SemVer with prerelease label and counter.

methods.name: prerelease_parts
methods.description: Splits prerelease string into label and counter.

methods.name: determine_next_version
methods.description: Calculates the next version based on current version, release channel, component, and label.

methods.name: write_file
methods.description: Writes content to a specified file path, creating directories as needed.

methods.name: update_version_file
methods.description: Updates the VERSION file with the new version.

methods.name: update_init
methods.description: Updates the __version__ variable in the init file.

methods.name: update_pkg_info
methods.description: Updates the Version field in PKG-INFO.

methods.name: update_requirements
methods.description: Updates agentfield version pin in requirements.txt files.

methods.name: update_go_template
methods.description: Updates the Go module version in the template file.

methods.name: update_ts_package_json
methods.description: Updates the version in TypeScript package.json.

methods.name: apply_version
methods.description: Applies the new version across all relevant files.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point for the version bump script, handling argument parsing and execution.
